generations.conceptPrompt: Late-1980s Eastern-bloc cash transit strongbox: a squat heavy steel chest with flat riveted panels, a thick lid with a hasp or lock on the front, and a carry handle at each end. Dark blue painted steel, rounded corner caps, two keyholes on the front, a rail top handle. Single object, orthographic-style three-quarter product shot from slightly above, the whole object in frame, plain flat light grey background, soft even studio light, no hands, no stand, no text, no logos, no watermark.
